historical_sample_use: diagnostic_only; never estimate or select candidate parameters; never promote a rule from the historical sample

activation.fixed_end_rule: first of 100 registered independent clusters or 180 calendar days after forward_start
activation.interim_peeking: operational completeness and safety only; no PnL comparison, parameter change, early promotion, or optional stopping

baseline.name: UNRESOLVED_CURRENT_X_BASELINE
baseline.mismatch: xtracker_tweet_watchdog.py uses consensus_v3_2026_07_16 while xtracker_paper_rebalance_ledger.py reselects entries with tightened_v2_2026_07_15 instead of replaying stored watchdog_actionable decisions
required_freeze_scope: machine-executable entry, rebalance, exit, sizing, monitoring-cadence, fee, latency, and settlement rules
source-data cut-off and UTC freeze timestamp

event_universe.source: every sequential xtracker Tweet/Post Count market returned by the registered discovery process; not only alerted, top-25, completed, or liquid rows
event_universe.registration_time: at first discovery, before outcome and before arm decisions
event_universe.candidate_rejection_treatment: zero-PnL no-trade outcome retained in paired comparison
event_universe.deduplication: one opportunity_id per condition_id; one cluster_id for the same account and overlapping resolution/exposure windows; adjacent or duplicate buckets remain one event lifecycle

candidate_arms.single_change: Reject when either post-latency full-quantity marginal ask or depth-walk VWAP exceeds 0.25; rejected opportunities remain zero-PnL paired observations.

Choose the greatest whole-share quantity whose post-latency depth-walk entry cost plus registered fees and one-tick adverse buffer is at most 10 USD; never exceed baseline quantity or displayed depth.

At the first registered five-minute monitoring decision where contemporaneous bid-side depth-walk VWAP is at or below 75% of entry VWAP, submit a paper exit; fill against the first separately captured post-latency book. Partial executable quantity exits and residual inventory remains marked as open, never discarded.

causal_timing_and_execution.clock: UTC with monotonic timestamps retained where available
causal_timing_and_execution.decision_book: raw CLOB payload captured with request start, response receipt, provider timestamp or sequence, endpoint, HTTP status, and SHA-256; never used as the fill book
causal_timing_and_execution.paper_order_latency: max(500 milliseconds, measured decision-book round-trip time)
causal_timing_and_execution.fill_book: first independently captured CLOB book at or after decision_complete plus paper_order_latency
causal_timing_and_execution.fill_model: walk raw contemporaneous asks for buys and bids for sells; record every level, partial fill, requested quantity, filled quantity, marginal price, and VWAP; never midpoint or a later convenience mark
causal_timing_and_execution.fees: use timestamp-valid CLOB fee-rate response and market fee metadata archived and hashed for each lifecycle; missing or inconsistent fee data is an evidence failure
causal_timing_and_execution.primary_slippage: post-latency depth walk plus actual registered fee schedule
causal_timing_and_execution.stress_slippage: primary execution with an additional two adverse ticks on every filled share
causal_timing_and_execution.settlement: independently archive and hash condition/outcome mapping, resolution source, final count, void/dispute status, and settlement timestamp

evidence_failure_policy.complete_case_result: reported but never sufficient for promotion
evidence_failure_policy.primary_intention_to_treat_sensitivity: assign each post-signal evidence failure the negative of that arm's planned worst-case event risk; promotion requires positive expectancy both with this assignment and under complete-case accounting

independence_and_accounting.cluster_algorithm: same social account plus overlapping market resolution window or overlapping open-exposure interval belongs to one cluster; all mutually exclusive buckets and rebalances within a condition remain one lifecycle
independence_and_accounting.cash_reconciliation: for every arm and lifecycle: initial cash - entry costs + exit/settlement proceeds - fees - slippage + residual inventory at settlement must equal final cash and net PnL
independence_and_accounting.capital_conflict_rule: when simultaneous eligible opportunities exceed the cap, allocate in deterministic ascending opportunity_id order for every arm

statistics.primary_estimand: mean net PnL per registered independent cluster under intention-to-treat accounting
statistics.paired_estimand: mean cluster-level candidate net PnL minus frozen-baseline net PnL over the identical registered universe
statistics.hypothesis_family: six one-sided tests: absolute expectancy and paired uplift for each of three candidate arms
statistics.multiplicity: Holm correction across all six tests
statistics.confidence_method: percentile cluster bootstrap with 50000 resamples, cluster_id as resampling unit, deterministic seed 20260720; report Holm-adjusted one-sided 95% lower bounds
statistics.small_sample_rule: no inference below 30 completed independent clusters per arm and 30 paired clusters; never substitute leg count for cluster count
statistics.economically_meaningful_threshold: point estimate of net PnL divided by committed risk must be at least 0.02 per cluster under primary execution and remain positive under two-tick stress
statistics.profit_factor: secondary diagnostic only; define as gross positive net PnL divided by absolute gross negative net PnL and report undefined when denominator is zero

promotion_gates.live_transition: never authorized by this protocol; requires a separate explicit user decision and safety review

audit_artifacts_required: append-only opportunity registry with sequence numbers
raw signal, decision-book, fill-book, fee, identity, and settlement URIs with separate SHA-256 hashes
baseline and candidate decision rows including rejections and no-trades
position, fill, lifecycle, cluster, and paired-comparison identifiers
amendment ledger; any substantive amendment resets forward_start and sample
current_hard_blockers: Immutable strategy copy/hash was blocked pending explicit filesystem consent.
Operational entry filter and historical ledger use different rule versions.
Frozen historical X sample has zero executable completed legs.
Public-record pipeline has zero net-capturable markouts.
